about_the_game:
Village Defenders – A strategic 2D tower defense game where you must protect your peaceful village from hordes of relentless enemies! Act smart, unlock unique upgrades, and deploy special abilities to fend off waves of monsters, undeads, and mythical creatures.

Plan your defenses wisely—each level introduces new challenges, tougher foes, and dynamic terrain. Will you hold the line, or will your village fall? Rally your forces, master the art of defense, and become the hero your people need!

🔹 Learn & Upgrade – Enchance your defender with unique abilities.
🔹 Diverse Enemies – Face waves of foes, each with different strengths and weaknesses.
🔹 Strategic Depth – Adapt your tactics with priorities and weaknesses for different enemy types.
🔹 Epic Boss Battles – Test your defenses against massive, fearsome bosses.
🔹 Endless Mode – How long can you survive against infinite waves?

Defend your home—Village Defenders awaits your command! 🏡⚔️🛡️
